description:
## Why

stoa-sieve-native supports fileinto, reject, variables, and regex.
RFC 5183 'environment' is missing. Without it, Sieve scripts cannot
test authentication results (DKIM pass/fail, SPF, DMARC) computed at
delivery time — operators must instead parse injected headers like
Authentication-Results: with fragile string matching.

## What

1. Add 'environment' to stoa-sieve-native's supported extension list
   and implement the environment test form.

2. Populate vnd.stoa.* environment values in stoa-smtp before the
   Sieve evaluator runs, sourced from the MessageAuthenticator results
   and the dns_auth_cache table.

## Environment values exposed

| Name                    | Values                              | Source |
|-------------------------|-------------------------------------|--------|
| vnd.stoa.dkim-result    | pass / fail / none                  | MessageAuthenticator |
| vnd.stoa.dkim-domain    | example.com (d= value) or empty     | DKIM-Signature header |
| vnd.stoa.spf-result     | pass / fail / softfail / neutral / none | MessageAuthenticator |
| vnd.stoa.dmarc-result   | pass / fail / none                  | MessageAuthenticator |
| vnd.stoa.dmarc-policy   | reject / quarantine / none          | dns_auth_cache or DMARC DNS lookup |

Standard RFC 5183 values also exposed:
| domain  | server hostname |
| host    | server FQDN |
| location | MTA |
| phase   | during |

## Example Sieve usage

```sieve
require ["fileinto", "environment"];

if environment "vnd.stoa.dkim-result" "pass" {
    fileinto "Verified";
} elsif environment "vnd.stoa.spf-result" ["fail", "softfail"] {
    fileinto "Spam";
}
```

## Acceptance

- require ["environment"] compiles without error
- environment "vnd.stoa.dkim-result" "pass" evaluates correctly
- environment with unknown name evaluates to empty string (RFC 5183 §4)
- stoa-smtp populates all vnd.stoa.* values before calling evaluator
- cargo test passes across stoa-sieve-native and stoa-smtp
title: Sieve environment extension (RFC 5183) with vnd.stoa.* auth metadata
